label: It is impossible that there be no mover that moves something while being…, by Well-founded-reductio
meaning: Suppose every mover is relevantly moved. By well-founded induction on the per se series: a moved thing has another mover; if that mover were moved in no relevant respect it would be a relatively first mover; so it is relevantly moved, hence a per se link one step up a series that cannot continue forever. So nothing is moved, contradicting sensible motion.
